BiblicalUsage: Nyx is night, the dark hours, literally and figuratively. Joseph takes the young child and His mother by night and flees to Egypt in Matthew 2:14, and in Mark 4:27 the seed springs up while the farmer sleeps and rises night and day.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God works in the night as well as the day, and the flight to Egypt and the growing seed both prove it.
